correctness.rationale: Fixing the hub action, a rim vertex agreeing with hub requires both adjacent rim vertices opposed for 0<λ≤2; an opposed rim vertex requires an agreeing neighbor only when λ<2. Thus hub-agreeing vertices are a maximal independent cycle set below 2, arbitrary independent set at 2, and empty above. Independence implies hub stability. Cyclic gap lengths 2/3 give refined n/z binomial counts, Perrin numbers, and welfare λ(n−z)+2z. Maximum cuts have z=floor(n/2), worst equilibria z=ceil(n/3); hence exact PoA and sharp sup 3/2. Independent brute-force all 2^(n+1) labeled action profiles n=4..9 for λ=1/2,2,5/2 matched counts and maximum/minimum weighted cuts exactly. Finite checks supplement full n argument.
